steps.name: Preposition
steps.notes:
Healers SW
Tanks NE
DPS wherever they want to be so long as they can identify their tether

steps.name: Dark and Light
steps.notes: 2 Short tethers and 2 Long tethers appear

steps.name: Supports Move
steps.notes:
Supports move to their markers
Short to A, C
Long to B, D

Short Tank takes aggro to keep the boss aiming at North

steps.name: DPS Move
steps.notes: DPS Move to marker depending on their tethered support, always on Intercardinals

steps.name: Arcane Revelation
steps.notes: Look at Boss for color of the cast

steps.name: Arcane Revelation
steps.notes: Move to the orb opposite of cast color

steps.name: Baits
steps.notes: Either baited aoe's or donuts will appear under each player where they got hit by the line AOE before

steps.name: LP / Pairs
steps.notes:
If it's Light, 4P stacks targeting the healers
If it's Dark, 2P stacks targeting either all DPS or all Supports

steps.name: Divisive Prepositions
steps.notes: Short tank to A to ensure boss points north

steps.name: Resolve
steps.notes: Do not move from these positions until the tethers have disappeared
